# Laundry Express

> Doorstep laundry pickup, wash-and-fold service, and delivery in Lake in the Hills, Illinois and nearby areas.

Laundry Express is a laundry service. Customers can review available service plans, check delivery coverage, and request a pickup online. Current prices, service availability, and pickup windows are shown on the website and may change.

## Public pages

- Home: https://laundryexpress.com/
- Pricing and plans: https://laundryexpress.com/pricing
- Contact: https://laundryexpress.com/contact
- Terms and guarantees: https://laundryexpress.com/terms
- Sitemap: https://laundryexpress.com/sitemap.xml

## Service information

- Laundry pickup and delivery coverage is confirmed during booking.
- Available plans, prices, scheduling windows, and add-ons are maintained by the business and displayed on the pricing and booking pages.
- Customers can track their orders and access account-specific documents after signing in.
- Only customers with completed orders can submit a review. Reviews may be subject to moderation.
